notes:
1) Screen recording: attached in Review Information (real device: home, a level played, the purchase screen, settings).
2) Purpose and audience: Midfold is a single-player arcade game made for iPhone Duo. Each close-then-open pump of the hinge is a wing flap (hinge angle via onHingeChange). On other iPhones and iPads you tap to flap. Ages 4+.
3) How to use: no sign-in. Tap Play. On iPhone Duo, hold it sideways, half open, and pump the hinge; elsewhere tap anywhere to flap. Paper Meadow and the daily course are free; tapping a Gusty Cliffs level or Endless opens the one-time purchase (All Worlds). Restore purchases is in Settings.
4) External services: Game Center (optional, leaderboards and achievements) and StoreKit. No other network access, no accounts, no ads, no analytics.
5) Regional differences: none.
6) Regulated content: none.

whatToTest.en-US: Pump the hinge to fly: hold the iPhone Duo sideways, half open, close it a little and open it again. Does every pump flap? Is the strength right (quick and deep = strong)? Try Settings > Pump sensitivity. Without a Duo, tap to flap.
whatToTest.tr: Uçmak için menteşeyi pompalayın: iPhone Duo'yu yan tutun, yarıya kadar açın, biraz kapatıp yeniden açın. Her pompa kanat çırpıyor mu? Güç doğru mu (hızlı ve derin = güçlü)? Ayarlar > Pompa hassasiyeti'ni deneyin. Duo yoksa dokunarak uçun.
